confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_10) transitioning from reading files to bulk downloading sensitive data across multiple departments (Legal, HR, Marketing, Engineering) during off-hours, which deviates significantly from their established baseline.

attack_chain.description: Initial reconnaissance: user_10 accesses a file in the Legal department, which is outside their normal directory baseline.
Expansion of scope: user_10 accesses shared runbooks during off-hours (19:57).
Transition to exfiltration: user_10 begins downloading files from the Legal department.
Bulk exfiltration: user_10 performs a series of rapid downloads across multiple unauthorized departments (HR, Marketing, Engineering) during late-night off-hours.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_10 had a legitimate business reason or an approved ticket for accessing these specific departments.
No information on whether the downloaded files were subsequently moved to an external location or personal device.
narrative: User_10, an executive, exhibited a classic insider threat pattern by gradually expanding their access from authorized directories to unauthorized departments (Legal, HR, Marketing, Engineering). The activity escalated from simple file reads to a concentrated burst of high-volume file downloads during off-hours, indicating premeditated data exfiltration.
